description: Decodes a JWT header and payload without verifying it, with warnings for alg none, missing or past exp, future nbf/iat and risky header fields. Returns { header, payload, signatureBytes, times: { exp, nbf, iat, expired }, verified: false, warnings, note } Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

token.description: Compact JWS (header.payload.signature). It is decoded only; do not send production tokens you cannot rotate.

title: JWT decoder
